title: B001: HSLM-1.95M — Ternary Language Model with Calibration Metrics v6.3
description: HSLM (Hierarchical Sacred Language Model) is a 1.95M parameter ternary language model achieving 123.9 perplexity on TinyStories. v6.3 adds uncertainty calibration metrics (ECE: 0.084, Brier Score: 0.234), Jupyter training analysis notebook, and statistical significance testing (p < 0.001 vs baseline). Uses {-1,0,+1} weights with 16× memory compression vs FP32, 19.2 pJ/OP energy efficiency, and 12.5× power reduction. Includes 95% confidence intervals, convergence analysis, and carbon emissions calculation (0.0044 kg CO2/year).
